purpose.summary: This program is a screen handler for the ORCA Japanese Medical Association standard receipt (claims) software system. It manages a patient list screen (screen S10) that displays patients with outstanding or pending receipt/payment records for a given billing month, including patient details such as name, sex, birthdate, age, and payment category. It handles screen initialization, navigation events, and entry/validation logic.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually Shift-JIS or EUC-JP stored as binary)
Multiple COPY statements for screen layouts (S02.INC through S10.INC, SERR.INC, SID*.INC) and data records
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
Bubble-sort implemented inline using PERFORM VARYING with index swapping
EVALUATE TRUE / WHEN conditions for multi-branch logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP (Message Control Program) table-access wrappers
OCCURS 101 table for patient list with composite sort key
BINARY (COMP) usage for row index (WRK-PTLIST-ROW PIC S9(9) BINARY)
verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the Japanese comments are almost certainly Shift-JIS or EUC-JP, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is part of the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by the Japan Medical Association (JMA), copyright 2002. The MCP-based DB access pattern (MCP-TABLE, MCP-PATHNAME, PERFORM 910-DBCLOSECURSOR-SEC) is characteristic of the ORCA/GnuCOBOL runtime environment rather than CICS or DB2, so 'online-cics' is used loosely to mean an event-driven screen program.
